items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'D.D.' (likely referring to a musician, possibly D.D. Goodson or related family) and his wife/sisters, but does not explicitly state a personal relationship with 'Goodson' himself, only mentioning the name in the context of family connections.

ctx.x: I'll go to Chani Bebe's wife on one of them. His wife played Dan? Yeah. D.D.'s sister. What's her name? D.D.'s wife was named Crosby last time. Uh-huh. Huh?
No, I wouldn't have been Goodson originally, but... But I don't know, there was a Sadie Crosby in that somewhere.

Chani Bebe's wife was a pianist. Yeah, her name was Crosby? Yeah, she had some sisters who played piano. Yeah. So I think there's a connection. I'm sure there's sisters. Yeah. D.D.'s wife and Chani Bebe's wife. Uh-huh. Or sisters. All the sisters played piano. They were from across the lake somewhere.
